allowedSourceMaterial.overview: The story of Elliot Tiber and his family, who inadvertently played a pivotal role in making the famed Woodstock Music and Arts Festival into the happening that it was. When Elliot hears that a neighboring town has pulled the permit on a hippie music festival, he calls the producers thinking he could drum up some much-needed business for his parents' run-down motel. Three weeks later, half a million people are on their way to his neighbor’s farm in White Lake, New York, and Elliot finds himself swept up in a generation-defining experience that would change his life–and American culture–forever.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What begins as a modest bid to save a failing roadside motel suddenly turns into half a million people descending on a quiet upstate farm.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Hoping to bring business to his parents' struggling Catskills motel, Elliot Tiber offers up local grounds for an ousted music festival, inadvertently sparking the massive gathering of Woodstock.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A warm, medium-paced blend of comedy and drama with moderate emotional weight and steady engagement.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Ang Lee reframes a legendary counterculture milestone through intimate family dynamics and the chaotic logistics of an unexpected historical turning point.

The overview names only White Lake, New York, as the location of the neighbor's farm, and 'Catskills' appears only in facts.keywords while allowedSourceMaterial.keywords is empty. This is an unsupported location concretization from keyword-only material.

description says Elliot 'offers up local grounds for an ousted music festival, inadvertently sparking the massive gathering of Woodstock'. The overview says he calls the producers hoping to bring business to his parents' motel, and that the festival ends up on his neighbor's farm. It does not say he offered any grounds. It also says he 'played a pivotal role' in making the festival 'the happening that it was', not that he started it, so 'sparking' overstates his causal role. Both points specify plot mechanics and causality that the packet does not state.
